fluff.overview: Capellan infantry serve where BattleMechs and armor cannot be spared, which in the resource-constrained CCAF means nearly everywhere. The Xin Sheng movement revitalized the infantry arm alongside every other facet of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces, giving foot soldiers better equipment and renewed purpose. Motorized platoons provide the CCAF with faster-moving infantry that can reposition between garrison posts or screen advancing forces along road networks. Their motorcycle and light vehicle transports sacrifice protection for speed, making them best suited to patrol and rapid-response roles. Support sections within the platoon carry portable machine guns that provide sustained automatic fire, giving the formation a significant volume-of-fire advantage in defensive positions at the cost of additional weight and ammunition bulk.
